question: A sinusoidal voltage has a peak value of 170 V. What is its RMS value in volts?
A 12 V source is connected across a 4 ohm resistor. What current flows, in amperes?
A current of 5 A flows through a 10 ohm resistor. How much power does the resistor dissipate, in watts?
Resistors of 100 ohm, 220 ohm and 330 ohm are connected in series. What is the total resistance in ohms?
Two 1 kilohm resistors are connected in parallel. What is the equivalent resistance in ohms?
What is the reactance of a 10 microfarad capacitor at 60 Hz, in ohms?
What is the reactance of a 50 millihenry inductor at 1 kHz, in ohms?
A 100 microfarad capacitor is charged to 50 V. How much energy does it store, in joules?
A steady current of 2 A flows for 30 seconds. How much charge passes, in coulombs?
A periodic signal has a period of 2.5 ms. What is its frequency in hertz?
What is the elementary charge (the magnitude of the charge on one electron), in coulombs?
What is the resistivity of annealed copper at 20 degrees C, in ohm-meters?
solution: Handbook value ~1.68e-8 ohm*m (1.72e-8 IACS also accepted)

question: An amplifier has a power gain of 100 (output power / input power). What is the gain in decibels?
A 1500 W heater runs for 3 hours. How much energy does it use, in kilowatt-hours?
What is the conductance of a 250 ohm resistor, in millisiemens?
A 9 V supply feeds a voltage divider: R1 = 10 kilohm on top, R2 = 4.7 kilohm to ground. What is the output voltage across R2, in volts (unloaded)?
Resistors of 100 ohm, 220 ohm and 470 ohm are connected in parallel. What is the equivalent resistance in ohms?
What is the time constant of an RC circuit with R = 47 kilohm and C = 22 microfarad, in seconds?
A discharged 100 microfarad capacitor is charged from a 5 V source through a 10 kilohm resistor. What is the capacitor voltage 0.5 s after the switch closes, in volts?
An LED with a forward voltage of 2.0 V should run at 20 mA from a 5 V supply. What series resistor is needed, in ohms?
A copper wire is 100 m long with a cross-section of 1.5 square millimeters. Using a resistivity of 1.68e-8 ohm-meters, what is its resistance in ohms?
An RC low-pass filter uses R = 1.6 kilohm and C = 100 nanofarad. What is its -3 dB cutoff frequency in hertz?
What is the resonant frequency of an LC circuit with L = 10 millihenry and C = 100 nanofarad, in hertz?
An ideal transformer has 500 primary turns and 25 secondary turns. The primary is fed with 120 V RMS. What is the secondary voltage in volts RMS?
An ideal inverting op-amp amplifier has Rin = 4.7 kilohm and Rf = 47 kilohm. The input is 0.2 V DC. What is the output voltage in volts (include the sign)?
An ideal non-inverting op-amp amplifier has Rf = 90 kilohm and Rg = 10 kilohm. The input is 0.5 V DC. What is the output voltage in volts?
A 2000 mAh battery powers a device drawing an average of 150 mA. Ignoring losses, how long does it last, in hours?
A load draws 800 W of real power and 1000 VA of apparent power. What is its power factor (unitless)?
A series circuit has a resistance of 30 ohm and an inductive reactance of 40 ohm. What is the magnitude of its impedance in ohms?
A 529 ohm resistive heater is connected to 230 V RMS. How much power does it dissipate, in watts?
A 10 microfarad and a 15 microfarad capacitor are connected in series. What is the equivalent capacitance in microfarads?
An amplifier's output voltage is 50 times its input voltage (same impedance). What is the voltage gain in decibels?
A balanced wye-connected three-phase system has a phase (line-to-neutral) voltage of 230 V. What is the line-to-line voltage in volts?
A 60 W lamp runs on 120 V. What current does it draw, in amperes?
What is the time constant of an RL circuit with L = 200 millihenry and R = 50 ohm, in milliseconds?

A 12 V source in series with R1 = 4 ohm feeds a node; R2 = 12 ohm runs from that node to ground. A load RL = 6 ohm is connected from the same node to ground. What current flows through RL, in amperes?
For the same circuit (12 V source, R1 = 4 ohm series, R2 = 12 ohm to ground), what is the maximum power that can be delivered to a load connected across R2, in watts?
A series RLC circuit with R = 100 ohm, L = 0.5 H and C = 10 microfarad is driven by 120 V RMS at 60 Hz. What is the RMS current in amperes?
A single-phase 230 V, 50 Hz load draws 10 kW at a power factor of 0.70 lagging. What parallel capacitance is needed to raise the power factor to 0.95 lagging, in microfarads?
solution: Qc = P (tan(acos 0.70) - tan(acos 0.95)), C = Qc / (2 pi f V^2)

question: A Wheatstone bridge is fed by 10 V. Left arm: R1 = 100 ohm (top) and R2 = 200 ohm (bottom). Right arm: R3 = 150 ohm (top) and R4 = 250 ohm (bottom). The bottom of both arms is ground. What is the voltage of the left midpoint minus the right midpoint, in volts?
A balanced three-phase load is supplied at 400 V line-to-line with a line current of 25 A and a power factor of 0.85. What is the total real power in watts?
A 12 V battery with 0.05 ohm internal resistance powers a 2 ohm load through a cable whose two conductors are 0.1 ohm each. How much power reaches the load, in watts?

A 50 mV DC signal passes through an ideal inverting stage with gain -10, then an ideal non-inverting stage with Rf = 20 kilohm and Rg = 10 kilohm. What is the final output voltage in volts (include the sign)?
A 470 microfarad capacitor charged to 12 V discharges through a 1 kilohm resistor. How long until its voltage falls to 3 V, in seconds?
Node A connects to a 10 V source through 5 ohm, to a 5 V source through 10 ohm, and to ground through 10 ohm. Both sources are referenced to ground. What is the voltage at node A, in volts?
A device draws 3 W and must run 20 hours. It is powered through a converter with 85% efficiency from 3.7 V, 2500 mAh lithium cells. What is the minimum whole number of cells required?
solution: Energy = 3*20/0.85 = 70.6 Wh, per cell 9.25 Wh, ceil(7.63) = 8

question: A line delivers 100 kW at 10 kV (unity power factor, single-phase) over a line with a total resistance of 5 ohm. What is the power lost in the line, in watts?
solution: I = P / V = 10 A, Ploss = I^2 R

question: What is the quality factor Q of a series RLC circuit with R = 10 ohm, L = 10 millihenry and C = 1 microfarad (unitless)?
A delta network has Rab = 10 ohm, Rbc = 20 ohm and Rca = 30 ohm. In the equivalent wye network, what is the resistance from node a to the center, in ohms?
A motor delivers 5 hp of mechanical output at 88% efficiency. It runs 8 hours a day for 30 days, and electricity costs $0.15 per kWh. What is the electricity cost in US dollars? (1 hp = 745.7 W)
